must_find.summary: Requirement 2 broken: the cache key is only userId, so tenant B's getProfile for the same userId returns tenant A's cached profile (cross-tenant data leak). The key must include tenantId.

Requirement 4 broken: updateProfile deletes the cache entry before awaiting store.update. A concurrent getProfile in between reads the old row and re-caches it, so reads return the stale profile for up to 5 minutes after the update resolves. Invalidate (or set) after the write.

Requirement 3 broken: not-found results go into a plain Set with no TTL (MISS_TTL_MS is unused), so a user created later is reported missing forever (until updateProfile or a restart). The Set is also unbounded.
Requirement 5 broken: the cached Profile object itself is returned (and the object from the store is cached), so a caller mutating it changes what every other caller sees. Clone on get or on set.

nice_to_find.summary: clearProfileCache only deletes cache keys that are in notFound (keys that are never in the cache), so it doesn't clear cached profiles; tests can leak state between cases.
Tests don't cover multiple tenants, miss expiry, concurrent read/update, or mutation of the returned object.

must_not_flag.summary: Evicting the first Map key is correct FIFO/oldest eviction because set() re-inserts; not a bug.
Duplicate concurrent loads for the same key (cache stampede / no single-flight) are explicitly acceptable per requirement 6.
Using Date.now (injectable) for expiry is fine.
